headline: Page Industries appoints Arjun Sunil Makhecha as Company Secretary and Compliance Officer
summary: Page Industries Limited has announced the appointment of Arjun Sunil Makhecha as its new Company Secretary and Compliance Officer, effective October 14, 2026. This routine corporate governance update involves a key compliance role within the listed innerwear manufacturer. Indian retail investors tracking the company note this as a standard administrative transition. Such appointments do not directly impact the operational earnings or stock valuation of the firm.
why_it_matters: Routine compliance change with no impact on stock price
